text:
Anya: Heads-up — customer AcmeHealth asked for per-tenant cost breakdowns tied to model variants; need to decide priority for Q2.
Sam: Is this the same as the cost attribution epic we scoped last quarter? See https://redwood.internal/notes/cost-epic.
Anya: Related but narrower — they want token-level mapping across hosted/dedicated/private and a dashboard tile showing delta by model variant.
Jordan: Engineering constraints: precise attribution across cache + batching + KV cache hits is tricky. We need tracing hooks to surface tenant_id and model_variant to the infer runtime.
Liz: From PM side, acceptance criteria: dashboard tile per-tenant, drill-to-trace link, and a cost-delta estimate between model versions. Must be usable for sales demos.
Nate: Proposed launch criteria (draft): (1) Dashboard surface + drill link + CSV export; (2) Tracing hook that preserves tenant_id and model_variant across reroutes/fallbacks; (3) Sampling-based verification tests and a small e2e smoke.
Sam: Rough dev estimate: runtime changes 3 sprints, UI work 2 sprints, plus 1 sprint for rollout/ops. Could be trimmed if we do sampling-first.
Anya: Sales will push as an enterprise ask. We need 3 prioritization options to present: small, medium, large.
Jordan: Small = sampling-only + attach tenant tag at request boundary (no per-token attribution). Medium = propagate tags through cache & batching for majority paths (per-token attribution for 95% of traffic). Large = full exact attribution across reroutes, cross-region fallbacks, and dedicated pools.
Liz: Risk note: Large touches runtime hot path and could regress tail latency. We'll need kernel-level benchmarks and a canary plan.
release-bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 2026-04-07T04:13:08Z — job id deploy-5172 (FYI).
Nate: Let's schedule a triage meeting tomorrow 10am to pick option and owners. @Kevin please join to present SRE impact.
Kevin: I can do 10am. I'll bring quantification on tail latency and memory overhead for KV propagation.
Anya: I'll draft acceptance criteria and user stories before the meeting and add privacy constraints.
Sam: Also add an eval prompt set to measure quality + cost tradeoffs. We should capture token counts and latency buckets.
Jordan: Quick snippet showing how a tracing hook could attach tenant and model metadata (pseudocode):
```
metadata = {
  "tenant_id": request.ctx.tenant_id,
  "model_variant": request.ctx.model_variant
}
span.set_attributes(metadata)
```
Liz: Nice. Operational concerns: we may need to hash tenant_id for compliance and to avoid PII in traces. Add that to spec.
Anya: Good call — privacy gating required. I'll add a compliance check to acceptance.
Kevin: I'll scope the privacy gating and a rollout plan with fallback toggles.
Anya: Ok merging notes into product doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/cost-attr-draft. Meeting invite sent.
Sam: :thumbsup:
